description: Find measure packages by CMS id, title words, steward or package id. Every word must match. Shared CQL libraries are packages too; pass kind "library" to search them.

collection.description: Limit to a collection, for example cms-fhir-2026 or community

dataModel.description: Limit to a data model, for example qi-core or sql-on-fhir

kind.description: measure (default), library for shared CQL libraries such as FHIRHelpers, or any

query.description: Words to match, for example "CMS122" or "diabetes glycemic"

name: search_measures
title: Search measures
